subject: RODBC works fine in Windows..not in red hat Linux for Shiny Server

messages.author: 3897bdfae4da6416
messages.subject: RODBC works fine in Windows..not in red hat Linux for Shiny Server
parts:
When i am trying to connect with Oracle  database..It works well in windows..But i am getting the error in red hat linux for shiny server

 

library(RODBC)


con <- odbcConnect ("abc", uid="abc", pwd="abc", rows_at_time = 500)

Warning messages:

1: In RODBC::odbcDriverConnect("DSN=abc;UID=abc;PWD=abc",  :

  [RODBC] ERROR: state IM002, code 0, message [unixODBC][Driver Manager]Data source name not found, and no default driver specified

2: In RODBC::odbcDriverConnect("DSN=abc;UID=abc;PWD=abc",  :

  ODBC connection failed.


Please help me to fix this error
